svg.title: My GitHub contributions over the last year, drawn as a city at night along the tracks, in a valley between two pine-topped rock hills: one tower a week, one window a day. Huginn the raven flies over and poops on each tower, splattering that week's windows in the shade of each day's contributions; then the splats slide off, tower by tower, and he comes back. 3,079 contributions, longest streak 67 days, busiest Oct 9 (170).

g.text: 3,079 contributions · longest streak 67 days · busiest Oct 9 (170)
